text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Summer has arrived and you're watching
Machan.
I'm here at camp, where the
food is delicious.
Yay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp season is upon us.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, that's right.
Trainer, I've had an
idea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we make a four-panel comic
that
shows me making the most of
summer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We could do "Machan eating
watermelon,"
"Machan going to a
summer festival," "Machan
catching
bugs"...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
People would get to see my loveliness
from a
more familiar angle... That's the
plan, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I think it's a good idea. A great idea,
even. I think
I'm going to be very busy
this summer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a relief to see Aston Machan in high
spirits
again after her spring slump.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When fall comes, it'll be time for the
Sprinters
Stakes. I want us to make the
most of this summer
and use it to
prepare!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you don't play around too
much during
summer camp! And read
through the guidebook
carefully. Got it?
Then you're free to go!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Residents
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right. Now that's done, I'm gonna
head to my
room for a bit and—

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Resident
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Hishiama! Have you seen this?
Aston
Machan did a live stream!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Resident
text_block_list.text:
We were talking on the bus about how
she's so
cool and direct, just like you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this is news to me! Sounds like
something
worth a watch!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Resident
text_block_list.text:
It was a while back, but after the Oka
Sho,
Machan did a stream where she
announced she
was going to focus on
sprinting instead of
entering the Tiara
tour!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wow, she streamed her announcement,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Resident
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! She didn't even tell her trainer
about it
until afterwards! She took a
stance and chose her
own path! That
sounds like something you'd do!
Don't
you think?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Well, y'know, I don't find it too
impressive that
she kept something so
important from her trainer
until after the
fact.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Resident
text_block_list.text: Huh? Really?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, really. Your trainer's supposed to
be your
partner, after all. They're the
last person you
should be keeping stuff
from.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...But I am kinda curious. I'll give it a
watch later.
